`native-clothing.ydd` and `native-rigid.ydd` are original, synthetic triangle fixtures generated by `native/CodeWalkerBridge.Tests/Program.cs` with the bundled CodeWalker serializer. They contain a three-bone test skeleton and two LODs. They are not GTA assets or production clothes.

`native-clothing.ytd` contém uma textura sólida original de teste. Os fixtures YDD possuem um shader ped_default sintético com DiffuseSampler para verificar materiais independentes e o round-trip de pintura do OBJ. Nenhum asset GTA é incluído.
